representation_note: 3D model drawn from published catalog and literature values, not measured by SPHEREx unless a fact says 'seen by SPHEREx' (each fact shows its source) - not an image. What no source gives is not drawn: an unknown temperature is drawn grey and an unknown size at a fixed marker size, not to scale. Sizes and distances may be exaggerated for visibility.

notes: Values checked on 2026-11-14 against the NASA Exoplanet Archive, SIMBAD (CfA mirror), Gaia DR3, VizieR and the cited papers (tasks/WS7-3d-systems.md, WS7-2). Facts still marked 'unverified' are estimates no source states. The 'seen by SPHEREx' facts were copied from the validation records (docs/validation/; AI analysis with an independent second analysis; the five records were human-reviewed on 2026-11-15, a guided review that did not re-run the analyses), not from that catalog cross-check.
Orbital and pulsation phases are arbitrary (no epoch): positions are not predictions for a real date.
Simplified hierarchy: Ba orbits A and Bb orbits Ba (no barycenters).
Ba and Bb have no published radius: their size is unknown and they are drawn at a fixed marker size, not to scale. The radius of Ab is the archive's estimate from its mass.

Gaia DR3 measures Ba+Bb as one unresolved source (RUWE 4.3): its parallax is not used for distance. SPHEREx also sees Ba+Bb as one source: they are never more than about 1″ apart (orbit semi-major axis 2.4 AU, 0.66″ at 3.64 pc; eccentricity 0.54), and a SPHEREx pixel is 6.15″.

WS3 object context of 'eps Ind B' (eps Ind B, Gaia DR3 6412596012146801152, match 'name'; catalog, not measured by SPHEREx): Effective temperature 1417 (1319-1515) K; Distance 3.692 (3.681-3.701) pc; Spectral type T1V+T6V; Variability type VBD (Ic 15.6-15.67). Not attached to Ba or Bb: Gaia DR3 and SPHEREx see Ba+Bb as one unresolved source (RUWE 4.30).

Catalog values from the frozen WS3 object-context snapshot 'eps-indi-b' (query 'eps Ind B'; services answered 2026-11-15T03:44:26Z to 2026-11-15T04:21:26Z; replayed offline from the WS3 fixtures), pipeline/errante/systems/inputs/objects/: not measured by SPHEREx, and not queried when the site is built.

Not measured, so not drawn (shown as unknown): Epsilon Indi Ba: radius (no published radius for Ba; no radius from the SPHEREx flux and the distance yet, WS7-8); Epsilon Indi Bb: radius (no published radius for Bb; no radius from the SPHEREx flux and the distance yet, WS7-8).
